    "Checked the full 15-file change from the base, the executable modes and contents of all 1,483 archived objects, the nine changed product paths, and the unmodified admission file. Built the Core and Capture sources independently on an ARM64 Mac using Apple Swift 6.4. The revised XCTest retains both assertions that failed on ARM64 and Intel in Native run 42395426552.",
    "An independently linked directory test opened an empty directory, added a file, then added a second after enumeration. The prior binary returned five empty snapshots in both the normal and rename cases. The rebuilt candidate returned 1, 2, 2, 3 and 3 authorized files in each case. The third snapshot recorded an unreadable neighbor as incomplete, and the fourth recovered it. The caller retained the same directory throughout. Same-named replacements, a symlink and a Finder-invisible file stayed excluded.",
    "The implementation owns a descriptor verified against the recorded directory identity. Each candidates() call creates its own stream from that descriptor, and child signatures are read from opened file descriptors. Path-based recovery rechecks the occurrence identity. For a controlled directory exchange at stream creation, ordinary CaptureService reconciliation and SQLite recorded exactly the original occurrence and matching private bytes. The normal control agreed. A legacy v2 checkpoint without directory identity recovered its known capture and retained the unresolved departure. Restoring a neighboring file permitted both original occurrences and cleared the resolved departure.",
    "With real Foundation bookmarks and isolated preferences, recreating the selected path stopped a live collector, preserved the original bookmark and yielded no assets before explicit reselection. Reselection yielded one private copy whose bytes matched. An unrelated system location remained eligible and malformed bookmark bytes survived. Reviewed the native selection panel, recheck, status and recovery action. The first-use guide conditions its selection action on needing source access; the ordinary Settings capture and help pages enable their chooser whenever the operation is available and a location is known.",
    "All 46 consumer bindings matched both their declared source and this checkpoint. The 43-entry prior manifest was archived byte for byte. The existing consumer checks passed 106 of 106. The privacy changes describe proposed deletion and recovery rules. Changes to screenshot attachment, database schema, release tooling, distributed packages, website and brand are outside this delta."
